title: occ/{occ}/head payload
description: UPSERT payload of occ/{occ}/head: the figure this copy is a copy of. Written with the copy's first status and re-pointed with one write (a wrong variant, an ER un-merge); never tombstoned by an ordinary removal, so a removed copy keeps its figure. Serialized, at most 172 bytes of UTF-8 as JSON.stringify writes it, under the Push cap MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES (65,536).

head_id.description: The spine product id, lowercase and dashed.

edited_at.description: When the user made the edit, in the device's local time with its offset (at most ±18:00). Display only; never compared, never restamped.

tz.description: The device's IANA time zone at edit time, e.g. America/Chicago. Display only.
